concept: A made-up heating firm's jobs board as one real whiteboard on a bottle-green wall, rendered in 3D (Blender) and shot from the same side three ways, the board changing each time. Whole: the week in marker capitals, one job underlined in red. Nearer and lower, along the board: somebody has leant on it and dragged Monday's and Tuesday's jobs into Wednesday. Then the foot of the board and its pen tray: wiped, the old week a ghost, and TEA ROTA in red. Bottle green, enamel white, brushed aluminium, black marker and one red.
